arguments.note: Said they pay suppliers on Fridays

examples.description: The client promised on the phone to pay by 5 October
Remove a promise recorded on the wrong invoice

failure_modes.recovery: Send the call the error's next_call names: invoice_update status 'sent' for a draft, invoice_read to read it again.
failure_modes.when: the invoice is a draft or cancelled, has nothing owed (paid, credited or written off), or changed since expected_updated_at

failure_modes.recovery: Call invoice_list and retry with an id from the list.
failure_modes.when: id / invoice_number does not name an invoice in your tenant

failure_modes.recovery: Fix the named field and retry.
failure_modes.when: an argument it does not take, both or neither of id and invoice_number, neither or both of promised_payment_date and clear, a date that is not YYYY-MM-DD, a date before today or more than 366 days ahead in the business's time zone, or a note over 500 characters

failure_modes.recovery: Tell the owner; the call works once migration DB_BUSINESS/0014 is applied. Nothing was changed.
failure_modes.when: the promised payment date is not set up in this environment yet (reason SIMPLER_SALES_PROMISE_UNMIGRATED)

preconditions: The invoice must be issued ('sent') with money still owed. The date is the business's own calendar date (sales_settings.timezone, unset = Asia/Singapore), stored as 12:00 UTC of that date.

promise_status is worked out on every read, never stored: kept when the invoice was paid in full on or before the promised business day, broken once that day has ended without it, pending until then. A new date replaces the old one; both stay in the activity.

description: Records the date a client promised to pay an issued invoice that still has money owed: promised_payment_date 'YYYY-MM-DD', the business's own date, today or later. clear true removes it. invoice_read then shows promise_status: pending until that business day ends, kept when paid in full by then, broken after it. A broken promise makes promise_follow_up the default purpose of invoice_message_prepare. Each change is kept in the invoice's activity as promise_set. Refuses a draft, a cancelled invoice and one with nothing owed (CONFLICT), and a past or malformed date (VALIDATION_ERROR). Nothing is sent. NEXT: invoice_read.

clear.description: true removes the promised date instead of setting one.

expected_updated_at.description: Optional compare-and-set guard: the updated_at you last read. A mismatch returns CONFLICT and changes nothing.

id.description: The invoice the client promised to pay (invoice_list shows ids); its invoice_number works too.

invoice_number.description: Alias of id — the invoice's own number.

note.description: What the client said, kept in the invoice's activity (max 500).

promised_payment_date.description: The business-local date the client promised to pay by, YYYY-MM-DD, today or later. Leave it out with clear true.

name: invoice_promise_set
